title: matlatl findings.json
description: The machine- and CI-consumable findings report emitted by `matlatl check --out <dir>` and `matlatl emit --out <dir>`. Every finding is self-contained and actionable: structured `details` plus a top-level `remediationGuide` keyed by finding kind. This schema is the published contract; the emitter type internal/infrastructure/emit.findingsDocument is kept in lockstep and a test validates emitted bytes against this document.

remediationGuide.description: Maps each finding kind present in this report to a standalone, one-paragraph how-to so an agent can act using only this document. Keyed by the finding kind string; a clean report yields an empty object.

okfConformance.description: OKF v0.1 conformance verdict (ADR 0023). ALWAYS present: when conformance mode was off, `checked` is false and the rest are zero values. When on, `conformant` is the §9 verdict, `version` is the bundle's declared okf_version ("" when none), and the three counts tally the okf-* Error findings.

checked.description: Whether OKF conformance mode (--okf / .matlatl.yml okf: true) was on for this run. When false, every other field in this object is a zero value and carries no meaning.

conformant.description: The OKF v0.1 §9 verdict. Meaningful only when `checked` is true; always false when the mode was off. True iff all three violation counts below are zero.

version.description: The okf_version declared in the bundle-root index.md frontmatter (OKF §11). Empty when none is declared — which is allowed, so a conformant bundle may still have an empty version.

details.description: Structured, machine-actionable context for the finding (e.g. target, candidates, expectedSlug). Keys are stable per ADR-aligned contract; omitted when empty.
